niche.habitat: Subsurface NH3-H2O eutectic oceans, near hydrothermal vent fields
niche.diet: Chemosynthetic grazers, smaller swimmers, ammonia-rich brine fauna

body: Streamlined, fluid-filled body; laminated iron-nickel carapace; electroreceptive rostrum; jaw-thoracic resonator

links: Prevents tissue collapse under crush pressure
Physical root: High surface pressure and fluid mechanics

skill.effect: Immunity to pressure damage and environmental hazards; -20% fall damage.

chains.weakness: Rapid temperature changes cause thermal stress; heat sources attract predators.

journal.en: A knife of bone and iron in the blue dark.

relations.note: (council kind 'Predator') Hidrazón may snatch juvenile Eridians near vent shafts; Eridians use sonic lures to deter them.

temperament: Ambush predator; solitary; highly territorial via acoustic maps
secrets: Hidrazón blood is a super-conductive brine; can craft high-efficiency electrical conduits.
Eating Hidrazón meat grants temporary pressure resistance but causes ammonia toxicity over time.
moments: In the black water, a flash of bio-electric blue illuminates a snout filled with needle-teeth; the sound of a clicker click echoes like a gunshot in the fluid.

journal.en: The deep ocean is a cathedral of pressure.
We build our walls high; the Hidrazón builds its teeth.
